notes: The gateway enforces authentication, event ownership, room binding, approval and idempotency. Sending remains disabled until desktop admission. The owner API is separate from MCP tools. Live dot and WeChat roundtrip validation is still required.

tools.name: wechat_get_connection
tools.description: Read the authenticated connection's stable profile ID, enabled state and authorized account/room IDs for event subscription. This does not read WeChat history or start collection.

tools.name: wechat_get_event
tools.description: Read an already-authorized cached event for the authenticated principal. Event IDs are not authorization. Never return credentials, other principals' data, or uncaptured chat history.

tools.name: wechat_get_context
tools.description: Read bounded, authorized cached context in the same principal, channel, account and source room as the event. Apply age and character limits server-side. No arbitrary history search.

tools.name: wechat_propose_reply
tools.description: Persist a reply draft only; never send it. Derive the source room from the authenticated event record. Reuse existing drafts only when scoped idempotency key and content hash match; reject conflicts. Return draft_pending, not sent.

text.description: Reply text; whitespace-only values are rejected by the server.

tools.name: wechat_send_reply
tools.description: Not exposed by default. Send only a server-stored draft with independently verified, unexpired owner approval bound to its exact content, principal, source room and policy version. Recheck access and rate limits, derive destination server-side, and never blindly retry an ambiguous delivery.
